name: ts-pp-mcp
description: Every TreasurySpring read endpoint, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers portfolio-level questions no single API call can: maturity ladders, obligor concentration, consolidated book, and event diffs.

ts_bearer_token.title: TS_BEARER_TOKEN
ts_bearer_token.description: Optional. Pre-minted bearer token. OR set TS_CLIENT_ID + TS_CLIENT_SECRET and run `ts auth login`.

ts_client_id.title: TS_CLIENT_ID
ts_client_id.description: Optional. OAuth2 client id; used by `ts auth login` to mint a token at /oauth/token.

ts_client_secret.title: TS_CLIENT_SECRET
ts_client_secret.description: Optional. OAuth2 client secret; used by `ts auth login`.
